comments.author: Vultify
comments.body_html:
Installation

  1. Download the mod and install it like any other mod.
  2. Download Ollama from ollama.com.
  3. In the Windows search bar, type terminal, then right-click it and select Run as administrator.
  4. Paste in the following command and hit Enter: ollama pull llama3.2
